reviewedRevision: f3185c5 plus the rework in this commit
process: Lean final review at the user's request: the known 4-level shortfall went straight to a retrofit, followed by one independent review round. Its two MEDIUM findings were fixed and verified with the reviewer's own probe scripts (blind3.mjs and pilot-run.mjs), one clean-worktree run and the browser check, without a second review round.
independentProbes: On the final files, the reviewer's own public-state pilot (pilot-run.mjs, seeds 1-4, 60 Hz) cleared 79 of 80 level runs at 0.25 s reaction and 76 of 80 at 0.35 s, with no breach or time-out. The reviewer's hold-and-sweep probe (blind3.mjs, sweep periods 1.4-3.8 s, 16 seeds) won at most 4 of 16 on any level from 3. In the review round, idle, hold-fire, plain sweep, mash and random keys stayed at or below 2 of 8; play was identical at 30, 60 and 120 Hz; 24 fuzz runs with hostile dt and pointer values threw nothing; wins and losses ended exactly once and stayed frozen; junk and throwing progress stores were safe; every EN/ZH tip matched its level.

findings.observation: Only 4 waves built from an if-chain, with no select or continue. There are now 20 data-driven levels (teaching 1-7, combination 8-14, mastery 15-20) with scouts, divers, artillery, gunner fans, warden pairs, leading aimed shots, armored scouts, bunker layouts and four bosses, each with an accurate EN/ZH tip, plus a level select and env.progress continue; the 1,261-line file is split into seven modules.

Review finding: holding fire and alternating Left and Right on a tuned period won up to 9 of 16 on level 9 and 37-42% on levels 4 and 19. Aimed rounds now fire as a three-shot crossfire led further ahead, levels 4 and 9 use three bunkers with armored scouts, and a test sweeps four periods on every level from 3.

Review finding: the formation reached the defence line after 34-46 s on levels 5 and 8, so a slightly slow player lost to breach. The fleet steps down 13 px instead of 18, several levels sweep slower, and the fleet now needs at least 56 s to reach the line with no kills. The first crossfire fix overcorrected (the reviewer's pilot fell to 66 of 80), so aimed-volley shares were lowered per level and the last two enemies fire at half rate.
The time-out loss now has its own EN/ZH message, distinct from the breach loss.

openNotes: Level 9 (Lead Shot) sits at the blind-sweep cap: a 1.4 s sweep won 4 of 16 in the owner's last run of the reviewer's probe.
The reviewer's pilot still loses level 19 by hull on some seeds; it is the hardest mastery level.
Bosses follow fixed patterns, so seeds do not vary them.
Bots stand in for players; human clear rates on levels 8, 9, 19 and the bosses are unmeasured.

browser.method: Official Claude in Chrome extension, local server; real clicks on Start, Play again, the language switch and the touch buttons, synthetic in-page keys; only DOM text and the canvas were read.
observed: English: Start opened wave 1 of 20 (Scout March) after its intro; held Left and Space moved the ship and destroyed an enemy (score 100).
English loss: the formation crossed the defence line and the loss screen said so; Play again restarted wave 1 with 3 hulls and 24 enemies.

Chinese 390 px phone frame (388 px inner, no horizontal overflow): the Fire touch button raised heat during the intro and then destroyed an enemy (24 to 23); the Right button's short simulated presses did not visibly move the ship, while the same input path fires correctly.
Final files (served fb487943 and 1542024f): a Chinese keyboard burst after the intro destroyed three enemies (24 to 21).
Not covered in the browser: a level win, the level select and the guard plate; the bots and the quality tests cover them.
